results.title: Student registration and login with multiple independent accounts
results.expected: Both students registered independently with unique IDs, correct login succeeds, bad password rejected
results.actual: S1 ID=63, S2 ID=64, Re-login=True, BadPassDenied=True

results.title: Multiple admin accounts with independent login credentials
results.expected: Multiple admin accounts created in MySQL with distinct credentials, both authenticate independently with role 'admin'
results.actual: Admin1 (ID=65, Login=True), Admin2 (ID=66, Login=True), Admin3 created via Controller=True

results.title: Correct student and admin role permissions (RBAC)
results.expected: Student blocked from admin pages & API (302/403); Guest blocked from student & admin dashboards

results.title: Student and admin dashboard data isolation
results.expected: Student 1 dashboard shows only Student 1's identity; Student 2 dashboard shows Student 2's; Admin displays aggregated MySQL data
results.actual: S1 Isolated=True, S2 Isolated=True, Admin Aggregates=True

results.title: Database persistence after logout and cold login
results.expected: User data and password hash persist in MySQL, allowing immediate re-authentication from a fresh session
results.actual: Cold login successful=True, User ID matched=63

results.title: Resource upload and download operations
results.expected: Valid PDF uploaded to MySQL resources, and download tracking record logged successfully

results.title: Discussion creation, comments, and study group operations
results.expected: Student 1 asks question, Student 2 posts answer to that question, and Student 1 joins study group
results.actual: Question Posted=True (DiscID=15), Answer Posted=True, Group Joined=True

results.title: Search, filtering, and category functions
results.expected: Resources filtered by faculty, keyword search works on resources and discussions
results.actual: Resource Filter=True, Resource Search=True, Discussion Search=True

results.title: Profile updates and notifications
results.expected: Profile bio and degree updated in MySQL; notifications marked as read

results.title: Session security and logout functionality
results.expected: Logout terminates session on server; subsequent access with previous cookie redirects to login

results.title: SQL injection and XSS protection
results.expected: SQL injection payloads safely rejected via prepared statements; XSS tags sanitized and escaped via htmlspecialchars

results.title: File upload security and access permissions
results.expected: Non-whitelisted executable (.php) uploads strictly rejected; .htaccess denies execution in uploads directory

results.title: Database foreign keys, indexes, and data consistency
results.expected: All 10 essential domain tables verified present with primary keys and indexed lookups in MySQL
results.details: Missing Tables: [], Primary Key Intact: True

results.title: All website buttons, links, forms, and navigation
results.expected: All 29 critical public, student, and admin routes return HTTP 200 with zero broken endpoints

results.title: PHP errors, warnings, notices, and clean execution
results.expected: Zero PHP Fatal errors, syntax parse errors, or unhandled exceptions logged during audit
